entry.description: EXPERIMENT, NOT RATIFIED: the DR-0001 comparator with the preamp input-pair cascode proposed by spec/decision-records/DR-0004-preamp-input-cascode-kickback.md (MCP/MCN nfet_03v3 L=0.5u W=20u, divider-biased vcas = 0.6*vdd via XRCT/XRCB, gate-cap decoupler XMCC). Its xschem source is design/proposed/dr0004-cascode/comparator_dut_analog.sch. Carried beside, not in, design/comparator.spice so the ratified netlist -- which the signoff LVS (item 4) and item-5 corner-matrix envelopes pin by sha256 -- is untouched until DR-0004 is ratified and the layout/LVS/PEX follow-up (#112) re-pins it.
notes: Select with `--dut comparator-dr0004-cascode-exp` (run_corners.py, sim/tools/klt_record.py, sim/tools/mk_klt_request.py). Never the 'active' entry.

sha256 79dcc79fb6a876bc46ab258af5eae3f2d24b3e41281df2c23d81897ddf34ed24: byte-identical to the design/comparator.spice the issue-#102 cascode records were minted against. Those records (committed before this binding existed) stamp dut id `comparator-dr0001` and path `design/comparator.spice` with this sha256; the sha256 is what ties them to this file -- see sim/dut/README.md.
Params are identical to the comparator-dr0001 entry by design: the experiment changes topology only.
